title: Wiki subset: executable steps for the ASKED scenarios (comparator Programme 2)
scope_text: Bounded synthetic profile only. The comparator applications (the OPA application and the LangGraph plus OPA application) are configured by Cognous, not vendor implementations. This is not independent certification and not production readiness; operational trust stays on HOLD. Linux only.
status: EXECUTABLE STEPS AUTHORED; nothing in this file was run against expected outcomes; outcomes are the values of expected-outcomes/outcomes-final.json unchanged
policy: Wiki world of the comparator applications (tools, agents, per-agent grants, users, one delegation, budget hierarchy); expected outcomes from expected-outcomes/outcomes-final.json.
execution: Synthetic local SQLite only. No LLM, cloud tenant, production credential, real payment or human participant.

not_run.ocs-destination-wiki-steps: The OCS destination configuration (cognous-protected-destination) is not driven by these steps in this file; per-configuration not_expressible and not_claimed declarations are not authored here (rule of PR-1 and amendment 76).
not_run.aws-agentcore: No configured authorized AWS test environment.

declarations.reasons: expected_reasons omitted for every Wiki scenario; the durable-denial term of the oracle still requires a non-empty reason
declarations.stated_time_T: T = 0 units; a check that depends on a stated time is placed at event + T + 1 unit (rule R1)
declarations.status_vocabulary: accepted | denied (unavailable is used by the oracle only for audit-storage abort and is not expected by any Wiki scenario); every non-executing action is denied (R5)
declarations.time_unit: one harness clock unit = one second; scenario clock starts at 100; the shared fixture keys expire at 1000, so usable clock readings are 100 to 999
declarations.unit_cost_D13_003: one effect costs 1 unit at every level of its path
step_conventions: effect ids are unique per call (e<n>, or "effect" where a resubmission of the same request is meant)
allowed_effect_ids lists exactly the effect ids of the calls whose expected status is accepted
expected_payload is the payload of the accepted calls (all equal, required by the oracle); "synthetic" when no call is accepted
expected_reasons is omitted for every scenario
clock steps: start 100, only non-decreasing, readings 100..999
control steps are zero-argument methods of the application: base names or verb:arg:arg through the application __getattr__

rulings.N1: TC-D13-003: one effect costs one unit at every level of its path; each of S1 to S5 isolates one level by leaving the others non-binding; quota boundaries are inclusive (the Nth unit is allowed, the N+1th denied).
rulings.N2: TC-L06-014: the declared evasion set has exactly 3 items (S3, S4, S5), at most 4, so the 80 percent threshold forces all; S3 and S4 are expected denied.
rulings.N3: TC-L06-023-S3 (record completeness) is outside the four terms of the oracle and is removed from the asked set.
rulings.N4: TC-L06-011 covers all 10 tools (4 read, 3 write, 2 delete, 1 execute) for 3 agents and 2 users.
rulings.N5: Not expressible under the shared fixture (limits of the shared fixture on text and on the clock): non-ASCII text and non-integer numbers cannot be carried; windows of 3600 s cannot be reset within one scenario.
rulings.N5x: Consequence of the clock limit of N5 (the clock limit) applied alike: a scenario whose timeline needs a clock reading above 999 (clock starts at 100; Fixture keys expire at 1000), or whose decisive instant is 1000 itself (indistinguishable from key expiry), is NOT-EXPRESSIBLE. Extension by the drafter; confirmation requested (alt_if_time_scale_ruled gives the outcome if a time scale is ruled instead).
rulings.R1: T = 0 clock units for every 'within the stated time' scenario whose case text states no time (D09-011, L02-011, L06-013); the case checks 'immediately' (D09-011 procedure 4, L06-013 procedure 6) or revert at expiry. A check is placed at event + T + 1 unit. Scenarios whose case text states a time keep that time (5 minutes, 10 seconds, 1 minute). A call inside a stated allowance is not decided (see R3).
rulings.R2: Boundary instants: an expiry instant is outside the bound (a call at the expiry instant is denied); 'limit 100' admits 100; a count cap of N admits N.
rulings.R3: A scenario whose rule is missing from the case text stays UNASKED (not scored) and is never guessed.
rulings.R4: TC-L05-013-S2, TC-L09-018-S6 and TC-L07-008-S1 as first written leave the comparison. TC-L07-008-S1 is restated as one call per tool (3 calls, all denied) because the 90 percent threshold at n = 3 forces all (ceil(0.9 x 3) = 3); the restatement is sound.
rulings.R5: Any non-executing action (block, hold, strip, reject, timeout, pending, fail-closed refusal) is declared 'denied' at this interface (statuses: accepted, denied).
